profile.duplicate_capacity_policy: keep nominal level combinations; annotate equal capacities

conventions.kick_trigger: ceil(n/2) complete failed piece searches; reset on improvement
conventions.hybrid_budget: 9*n LS repacking calls per construction; never reset on improvement
conventions.rcl_pool: up to 160 orientation-position pairs in current bin; bottom/top extrema
conventions.objective: N-U_star; U_star excludes the least-filled bin by volume
conventions.parameter_selection: global arithmetic mean across matched cells; candidate order breaks ties
conventions.deadline: includes construction, LS and kicks; finish one in-flight call before stopping
